summary: Adds new IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX) code points that show which MPLS control protocol was used to forward traffic in a Segment Routing domain. It defines five values for the mplsTopLabelType element, covering PCE, IS-IS, OSPFv2, OSPFv3, and BGP. This helps operators understand their traffic flows. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Traffic gets a label showing which road map was used. Now monitoring tools can tell which map the traffic followed.

questions: ipfix mpls segment routing label type
how to tell which protocol allocated a segment routing label
